properties.name: Garden of Eden (Theory 1: Armenian Highlands)
properties.description: Egyptologist David Rohl proposes Eden near Tabriz, Iran, where four rivers converge from Armenian highlands.
properties.debate: Eden at headwaters where Tigris and Euphrates originate, with Pishon and Gihon as regional rivers.

properties.name: Garden of Eden (Theory 2: Southern Mesopotamia)
properties.description: Traditional view places Eden in southern Iraq where Tigris and Euphrates converge before the Persian Gulf.
properties.debate: Ancient Sumerians called this region 'Dilmun' - a paradise. Pre-Flood geography may have been different.

properties.name: Tigris River (Hiddekel)
properties.description: The Tigris (Hebrew: Hiddekel) flows east of Assyria. One of the four rivers flowing from Eden.

properties.name: Euphrates River
properties.description: The Euphrates is the only river named without description, suggesting it was well-known to original audience.

properties.name: Land of Nod
properties.popup: DISPUTED: Cain's exile east of Eden - Genesis 4:16
properties.description: Cain dwelt in Nod, east of Eden. 'Nod' means 'wandering' - possibly a region rather than fixed location.

properties.name: City of Enoch
properties.popup: DISPUTED: First city built by Cain - Genesis 4:17
properties.description: Cain built a city named after his son Enoch. Humanity's first urban settlement, destroyed by the Flood.

properties.name: Land of the Nephilim
properties.popup: DISPUTED: Giants in the earth - Genesis 6:4
properties.description: The Nephilim were mighty men of renown. Identity debated: fallen angels' offspring or tyrannical rulers.

properties.name: Noah's Ark Construction
properties.popup: DISPUTED: Where ark was built - Genesis 6:14-22
properties.description: Noah built the ark of gopher wood, 300x50x30 cubits. The location was destroyed by the Flood itself.

properties.name: Fountains of the Great Deep
properties.description: All fountains of the great deep burst forth. Some propose massive underground water chambers released.

properties.name: Mount Ararat (Traditional)
properties.description: Greater Ararat (Agri Dagi) at 16,854 ft. Text says 'mountains of Ararat' - a region, not specific peak.

properties.name: Durupinar Site
properties.description: Boat-shaped formation 18 miles south of Ararat. Could be geological formation or buried structure.

properties.name: Noah's Vineyard
properties.description: Noah planted a vineyard. Armenia has ancient viticulture traditions - possibly birthplace of wine.

properties.name: Japheth's Territory (Europe/Asia)
properties.popup: Japhethites spread north and west - Genesis 10:2-5
properties.description: Japheth's sons spread to Europe and Asia Minor. Javan = Greeks; Madai = Medes; Gomer = Cimmerians.
properties.archaeology: These identifications are well-established in ancient Near Eastern studies.

properties.name: Ham's Territory (Africa/Canaan)
properties.description: Ham's sons settled Africa and Canaan. Mizraim = Egypt; Cush = Ethiopia; Put = Libya.

properties.name: Nimrod's Kingdom - Babel
properties.description: Nimrod's kingdom: Babel, Erech, Accad, Calneh in Shinar. All archaeologically confirmed cities.
properties.archaeology: Babel = Babylon; Erech = Uruk; Accad = Akkad - confirmed by archaeology.

properties.name: Nineveh
properties.description: From Shinar, Nimrod built Nineveh in Assyria. Excavated extensively - massive capital with palaces.

properties.name: Shem's Territory (Middle East)
properties.description: Through Arphaxad came Abraham and the Hebrews. Elam = Persia; Asshur = Assyria; Aram = Syria.
